tools.description: Start here to resolve a product name to its url_name, then call get_software for details (structured license, pricing, rating, links) or get_alternatives for its alternatives.
To find which OpenAI docs page or section answers a question before reading it with get_page.

To find Anthropic engineering posts (agent evals, tool search and deferred tool loading, building effective agents, postmortems), recent announcements to monitor, or research posts, before reading one with get_post.
To see what changed in the OpenAI API recently, or when a model or feature was released.
To see which OpenAI models exist, find a model ID, or pick a recommended model before calling get_model.
To compare OpenAI model prices or get the official per-token price of a model in a given processing tier.
To check a model's context window, price, cutoff, endpoints or rate limits from OpenAI's own docs.
To check whether an OpenAI model or endpoint is deprecated, when it shuts down and what replaces it.
To compare where to run a given model: prices and measured speed per provider. Needs a model slug from search_models.
To look up the parameters and response schema of an OpenAI API endpoint.

List a channel's Shorts, newest first, paged by continuation.
List a channel's uploads, newest first, paged by continuation.
Read a comment thread after video_comments.
List the videos in a public playlist, paged by continuation.
Turn a handle or a pasted channel URL into a channel_id.
Find videos by topic or by an author's name before fetching details, transcripts or comments.
Public reaction to a video; follow replies_continuation with comment_replies for a thread.
Start here for a video's identity and to see which transcript languages exist before calling video_transcript.
